name: iotfleetwise
description: Amazon Web Services IoT FleetWise is a fully managed service that you can use to collect, model, and transfer vehicle data to the Amazon Web Services cloud at scale.

subcommands.name: associate-vehicle-fleet
subcommands.description: Adds, or associates, a vehicle with a fleet.

subcommands.name: batch-create-vehicle
subcommands.description: Creates a group, or batch, of vehicles.

subcommands.name: batch-update-vehicle
subcommands.description: Updates a group, or batch, of vehicles.

subcommands.name: create-campaign
subcommands.description: Creates an orchestration of data collection rules.

subcommands.name: create-decoder-manifest
subcommands.description: Creates the decoder manifest associated with a model manifest.

subcommands.name: create-fleet
subcommands.description: Creates a fleet that represents a group of vehicles.

subcommands.name: create-model-manifest
subcommands.description: Creates a vehicle model (model manifest) that specifies signals (attributes, branches, sensors, and actuators).

subcommands.name: create-signal-catalog
subcommands.description: Creates a collection of standardized signals that can be reused to create vehicle models.

subcommands.name: create-state-template
subcommands.description: Creates a state template.

subcommands.name: create-vehicle
subcommands.description: Creates a vehicle, which is an instance of a vehicle model (model manifest).

subcommands.name: delete-campaign
subcommands.description: Deletes a data collection campaign.

subcommands.name: delete-decoder-manifest
subcommands.description: Deletes a decoder manifest.

subcommands.name: delete-fleet
subcommands.description: Deletes a fleet.

subcommands.name: delete-model-manifest
subcommands.description: Deletes a vehicle model (model manifest).

subcommands.name: delete-signal-catalog
subcommands.description: Deletes a signal catalog.

subcommands.name: delete-state-template
subcommands.description: Deletes a state template.

subcommands.name: delete-vehicle
subcommands.description: Deletes a vehicle and removes it from any campaigns.

subcommands.name: disassociate-vehicle-fleet
subcommands.description: Removes, or disassociates, a vehicle from a fleet.

subcommands.name: get-campaign
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about a campaign.

subcommands.name: get-decoder-manifest
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about a created decoder manifest.

subcommands.name: get-encryption-configuration
subcommands.description: Retrieves the encryption configuration for resources and data in Amazon Web Services IoT FleetWise.

subcommands.name: get-fleet
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about a fleet.

subcommands.name: get-logging-options
subcommands.description: Retrieves the logging options.

subcommands.name: get-model-manifest
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about a vehicle model (model manifest).

subcommands.name: get-register-account-status
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about the status of registering your Amazon Web Services account, IAM, and Amazon Timestream resources so that Amazon Web Services IoT FleetWise can transfer your vehicle data to the Amazon Web Services Cloud.

subcommands.name: get-signal-catalog
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about a signal catalog.

subcommands.name: get-state-template
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about a state template.

subcommands.name: get-vehicle
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about a vehicle.

subcommands.name: get-vehicle-status
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about the status of campaigns, decoder manifests, or state templates associated with a vehicle.

subcommands.name: import-decoder-manifest
subcommands.description: Creates a decoder manifest using your existing CAN DBC file from your local device.

subcommands.name: import-signal-catalog
subcommands.description: Creates a signal catalog using your existing VSS formatted content from your local device.

subcommands.name: list-campaigns
subcommands.description: Lists information about created campaigns.

subcommands.name: list-decoder-manifest-network-interfaces
subcommands.description: Lists the network interfaces specified in a decoder manifest.

subcommands.name: list-decoder-manifest-signals
subcommands.description: A list of information about signal decoders specified in a decoder manifest.

subcommands.name: list-decoder-manifests
subcommands.description: Lists decoder manifests.

subcommands.name: list-fleets
subcommands.description: Retrieves information for each created fleet in an Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: list-fleets-for-vehicle
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of IDs for all fleets that the vehicle is associated with.

subcommands.name: list-model-manifest-nodes
subcommands.description: Lists information about nodes specified in a vehicle model (model manifest).

subcommands.name: list-model-manifests
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of vehicle models (model manifests).

subcommands.name: list-signal-catalog-nodes
subcommands.description: Lists of information about the signals (nodes) specified in a signal catalog.

subcommands.name: list-signal-catalogs
subcommands.description: Lists all the created signal catalogs in an Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: list-state-templates
subcommands.description: Lists information about created state templates.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Lists the tags (metadata) you have assigned to the resource.

subcommands.name: list-vehicles
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of summaries of created vehicles.

subcommands.name: list-vehicles-in-fleet
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of summaries of all vehicles associated with a fleet.

subcommands.name: put-encryption-configuration
subcommands.description: Creates or updates the encryption configuration.

subcommands.name: put-logging-options
subcommands.description: Creates or updates the logging option.

subcommands.name: register-account
subcommands.description: This API operation contains deprecated parameters.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Adds to or modifies the tags of the given resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes the given tags (metadata) from the resource.

subcommands.name: update-campaign
subcommands.description: Updates a campaign.

subcommands.name: update-decoder-manifest
subcommands.description: Updates a decoder manifest.

subcommands.name: update-fleet
subcommands.description: Updates the description of an existing fleet.

subcommands.name: update-model-manifest
subcommands.description: Updates a vehicle model (model manifest).

subcommands.name: update-signal-catalog
subcommands.description: Updates a signal catalog.

subcommands.name: update-state-template
subcommands.description: Updates a state template.

subcommands.name: update-vehicle
subcommands.description: Updates a vehicle.
